text:
Dara Holt: Quick flag  QuotaQ sent renewal INV-QQ-2026 and AP rejected it because the SKU mix doesn't match our negotiated pilot terms. The PDF lists 50k included calls/month and 20 seats; we were on a consumption pilot. Can someone take a look?

Kenji Sato: Upload the invoice link? I'll pull the usage.

Dara Holt: Link: https://files.redwood/procurement/quotaq_renewal_may.pdf  top lines: Standard Plan $48k/yr (20 seats + 50k/mo), onboarding $4k, overage $0.009/call.

Liam Ortiz: Our telemetry shows last quarter: 2026-02 310k, 2026-03 295k, 2026-04 330k -> ~3.9M/yr. Definitely not a 50k/mo seat bundle.

Claire (QuotaQ Sales): Hi Dara/Kenji/Liam  apologies, our renewals engine picked the wrong template. We can convert to committed consumption. Two quick options: (1) 4M calls/yr @ $0.0048/call + 5 admin seats $1,500 = $21,700/yr; (2) 6M calls/yr @ $0.0039/call + 5 seats $1,500 = $24,900/yr. Both waive onboarding for pilots and include monthly invoicing that shows math.

Dara Holt: Thanks Claire. Procurement wants the following in writing before we route to Finance: explicit 12-month price lock, monthly overage cap in USD (prefer $3k/mo), pilot termination rights (60 days), Net30 payment, DPA + SOC2, and corrected invoice for AP showing line-item math. Also request a one-time credit for the billing mistake.

Kenji Sato: Also confirm whether the included calls in option 1/2 are per-org or per-seat and whether unused included calls roll over monthly. That affects our forecast.

Claire (QuotaQ Sales): Included calls are per-organization, no rollover. We can add a clause to allow a one-time annual rollover up to 10% if needed. We can offer a $2k account credit to offset the template error.

Liam Ortiz: The rollover clause is useful. For budgeting we prefer a hard dollar overage cap rather than % of commit. Please put $3k/mo cap in SOW for year 1. Claire, can you also confirm invoice will be updated to: "Committed Consumption - 4,000,000 calls @ $0.0048 = $19,200 + seats $1,500 = $20,700" (numbers example). AP needs that to map GL codes.

Claire (QuotaQ Sales): Will update invoice exactly like that and post a corrected PDF. I can lock the 12-month price if we sign by EOM and will add the $3k/mo first-year cap, 60-day pilot termination, Net30, DPA & SOC2 attach. Adding the $2k credit as a line item.

Dara Holt: Legal side: please confirm indemnity and data deletion terms in the DPA. Also ask whether QuotaQ uses subcontractors for analytics and where logs are stored (region).

Claire (QuotaQ Sales): DPA will list subprocessors and note logs stored in us-east-1 by default; deletion within 30 days after termination. Indemnity: standard mutual indemnity; we'll share the DPA draft.

APBot: Reminder: commits > $25k/yr require FinanceOps approval and a PO. See https://intra.redwood/finance/commit-approval. If we accept the 6M option, that's below $50k but still needs FinanceOps.

Kenji Sato: Attach usage snapshot we'll include in counter so they see the pattern:
```
month,api_calls
2026-02,310000
2026-03,295000
2026-04,330000
```

Dara Holt: Claire, can you post the corrected invoice and a redlined contract here? We'll do a quick internal review and then route to FinanceOps. If the 6M option nets a lower effective $/call and FinanceOps approves, we may go for that.

Claire (QuotaQ Sales): Uploading now: https://docs.redwood/contracts/quotaq-counter-05.md and corrected invoice posted to files. Will follow up with a clean PDF and editable redline.

Liam Ortiz: Reviewing docs now. One more ask: include a 90-day data export window after termination in the SOW for migrations.

Claire (QuotaQ Sales): Can do 90-day export window and will add it to SOW.

Dara Holt: Great. Once redline is finalized I'll thumbs-up and escalate to FinanceOps. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
